# 05 - Return-line writer, reader and staged migration integration
version: 001
date: 2026-10-31
who: Codex Prime
state: prepared for named Director invocation
Face: 05
PPPP: 0521

## Assignment
Executor: Grok-1. Reviewer: Codex Prime.
Workspace D:/Git/lib-build, branch workshop. Verify evidence/pack05.03/source-manifest.json.
Record invocation/claim below. Read the full 05.02 Prime review and the shared
0417.return-placement/evidence/integration-seam-v1.md before code.
The Director requested these parallel integration packs. Neither releases live
migration, seating or adoption. No sequential N1NN allocation; existing page-local
submission/evidence is durable with matching-line custody explicitly pending.

## #01 - implement the new-work route, not another plan only
Build labs/return-lines-pass01 as the canonical line/pass reserve, capture, verify,
lookup and migration tool. Reuse the reviewed placement candidate and pinned /1
reader without changing their files. Preserve original sealed bytes. Provide a
documented runnable CLI and new app/return_line_tools.py plus an explicit pin
declaration if useful; do not edit app/librarian.py or shared existing app facades.
No new status engine. The work book is the record. Consumer input/output follows
the shared descriptor contract. Plan exact legacy compatibility and version new
reservation/receipt schemas rather than silently changing existing preimages.

## #02 - new work, exact routing and descriptor
N5NN work gets one matching N1NN.subject line with per-pass records; multiple passes
never consume more page addresses. N7NN stays page-local with its existing tails.
Reject undeclared kinds. Enforce origin/pass/subject and expected outputs at every
write and lookup. Same identity/bytes is idempotent; conflicting bytes are retained
and refused. Incomplete/reserved is not done. Emit the shared descriptor from actual
verified records; neither a caller boolean nor copy completion establishes custody.
New capture must preserve exact return/artifact bytes and durable provenance.
Implement a fixture-tested book routing declaration for the corrected interface.

## #03 - staged migration and retirement implementation
Implement a resumable, inspectable two-phase migration against an explicit book
and backup/staging root. Revalidate exact plan/audit/source identities first. Work
from lowest original capture upward. Stage and verify EVERY source before retiring
an occupied address. Preserve original directory identities, full /1 bytes and a
verified rollback copy outside the active page namespace. Never delete the only
copy or overwrite a different subject. Account for all 18 occupancy conflicts.
After staging is complete, a separate explicit adoption phase can retire verified
legacy occupants and construct final matching lines, preserving old-to-new lookup.
Each phase has a durable journal and explicit completion marker. A crash cannot
turn partial staging/adoption into completion. 0154 stays incomplete. Existing N7
return tails are checked for equality; all custody provenance is preserved locally.
Migration hashes and destination identities must remain inspectable through lookup.

## #04 - enforce integration without concurrent shared-pin edits
The future active pack-preparation and capture route must call this canonical tool.
Produce an EXACT integration patch proposal (affected source/pins and tests) that
retires old sequential writes for a book declaring this layout while preserving
old-format reads. Do not edit those shared pinned dependencies in this parallel
pass: Grok-2 relies on their reviewed identities. Prime will apply/review that
coordinated pin/facade change once both lanes freeze. Mark live enforcement pending
until then. Do not claim a new unused helper alone enforces the current book.

## #05 - acceptance lab and live read-only plan
Prove new task reservation/capture/verification and two passes on one correct line,
N7NN local placement, wrong origins/outputs, byte conflicts and stale source checks.
Rehearse full migration on a disposable COPY of the audited capture set plus needed
page-local Colab returns: all 83 sources, all hashes, all occupancy dependencies.
The copy is for testing; originals stay untouched. At least one interrupted stage,
adoption and rollback must be tested, preserving evidence and stopping on mismatches.
After migration, every complete historical return remains retrievable from old id
and new origin/pass; exact original bytes match. Incomplete 0154 remains visible.
File your synthetic new work through the new tool too, not an invented success.
Generate a new live READ-ONLY plan for Prime, including post-audit changes and
preconditions. No live apply/adoption/retirement in this pack. No blanket fixture
guard removal as a shortcut. No held AR-01 inventory/bridge/race fixtures.

## Inspectability and scope
Refusals name the applicable contract/check and preserve input or partial evidence
with an actionable correction/escalation route. Unknown law is not an invented
format rule; compute never decides meaning. Use the recorded Director direction.
Allowed writes: labs/return-lines-pass01, app/return_line_tools.py and its NEW pin
declaration, 0521/06.05.md, evidence/build05.03 and this batch pointer. Do not modify
labs/return-placement-pass01, existing helper/inspector/app modules, 0522 or shared
contract. Fixture and backup paths must be checked for containment before recursive
operations. No live moves, source deletion, installations, paid calls or Git writes.

## Handback
Write 06.05.md notes and evidence/build05.03/CONTRACT.md before implementation.
Return evidence/build05.03/submission.md starting Did, Blocked, Need; CONTRACT.md,
PRIME-USE.md, verification.json, artifact-manifest.json, integration-patch.md and
the actual raw tests/demo/request/result evidence. Bind all new/changed code and
dependencies. Full reread and integrate notes. Preserve earlier evidence and failures.
Append submission and manifest hashes below; custody stays pending matching
0121.return-placement after migration.
No old allocator, invented receipt, 0184 or work hidden only in chat.

## Review - Codex Prime

date: 2026-11-01
who: Codex Prime
state: bounded migration/capture candidate checks passed; live adoption not performed

### What finished and what was rerun
Shutdown interrupted Prime's combined review, not the builder's completed return.
Last night's return-lines suite had seven passing results, but the combined summary
was stale. Prime preserved those logs and reran both suites into a new evidence
folder. Earlier sandbox fixture PermissionErrors are environment failures, not
product test failures. The successful rerun used the available Windows Python
3.12.14; Grok-1 reported Python 3.14.0 separately.

### Verified evidence
All 18 source pins match live bytes and frozen snapshots. All 37 artifact rows
match. Submission and manifest hashes match the recorded return pointer.
Prime reran all seven return-line tests: seven passed, no skips. They exercise
matching routes, multiple passes on one line, page-local Colab, duplicate and
conflicting captures, altered receipts, live-book refusal, stage interruption,
stale sources, rollback, incomplete returns and changed tails.
Prime independently repeated the full rehearsal on a disposable copy: 83 audited
records and five Colab tails, 1209 copied files; stage interrupted and resumed;
adopt, rollback, adopt again; 18 occupants retired only in the copy; a new synthetic
pass captured on the matching line. No rehearsal problems were reported. The
before/after fingerprint is identical, live member directories unchanged, and
0154 remains incomplete. Raw rehearsal and test results are preserved here.

### Joint-tool finding
Prime generated a real capture with this tool and gave its unchanged descriptor
to the returned 0522 loop. Capture verification was complete, but the consumer
reported conflict: target_page is interpreted as the review-face destination;
the producer means the matching return page. The producer's custody_path is a
directory; the consumer insists on a regular file. This prevents joint operation.
The producer's placement follows the agreed N5NN to N1NN relation. Prime's shared
seam listed field names without fixing each path's object type clearly enough;
that ambiguity is a design gap Prime must clarify, not grounds to silently alter
records or shift the fault entirely to a builder. See 0522/05.03 for consumer
verification defects and the diagnostic probes. Do not alter this tool merely
to satisfy the consumer's synthetic fixtures.

### Disposition and next action
The reviewed candidate passes the bounded capture/migration checks above. This
is not live acceptance, race-freedom proof, seating or permission to migrate.
Existing app callers still use the old route until a coordinated integration is
reviewed. Keep the accepted candidate bytes frozen while repairing the consumer
and clarifying the adapter. Then test both tools against real new and relocated
legacy records before a separately controlled live move. Custody for this return
remains pending 0121; no 0184 allocation or fabricated receipt was made.
